basis.rule: Bases are Land_Mil_ rows (no tents or guard booths) linked at 120 m with at least 4 rows. The approach is the bearing from the base centre to the nearest vanilla guard booth 60 m or more away (within the base extent + 350 m), else to the nearest settlement (no road data offline). Per base, in rounds: a forward outpost on the approach, an MG nest 35 degrees to the left, a comms post behind the base, then an MG nest 35 degrees to the right. Each site is found by walking out from the base edge along its bearing in 10 m steps with bearing offsets of 0, 12 and 24 degrees, and is kept only if every piece clears vanilla groups by 10 m and has flat vanilla height support.

purpose: Forward outposts, MG nests and comms posts at the approaches to the vanilla military bases and barracks clusters.
